Outer start sets current identity before inner start. Inner immediately writes inProgress/resting/decision/current counts/battleNumber1/trainers[] before rejecting nonpositive numRounds; old numRounds and later start/oldParty/activeparty/save writes have not happened on that rejection.

Successful start retains oldParty by reference, replaces active party only when stored party is truthy (including empty array), and requests Game.save(safe:true) with decision already0.

Entry UI normal ret nil does not submit and wrapper returns nil; empty array is truthy so submits then wrapper returns Booleanfalse; nonempty submits and returns true. Direct SetParty itself stores/returns the submitted value, not this Boolean conversion.
SetParty writes active player party immediately only if inProgress, then stores the same submitted reference. Outside progress it only updates stored registration for later start.

Cancel restores oldParty only if truthy then resets exactly inProgress/resting/start/decision/wins/swaps/battleNumber/trainers/oldParty/party/extraData. It preserves numRounds, outer current identity, outer rules/types/counters and requests neither save nor refresh.

Outer end when identity!=−1 first saves type counters from current inner data then sets identity−1 before inner end; identity−1 bypasses type recovery. Winningdecision1 retains currentcounts; all other nonzero decisions zero currentcounts but update previous/max; decision0 zeroscurrent only and retains previous/max.

Inner end unconditionally assigns active player party=oldParty before checking inProgress. Inactive returns with that write and no reset/refresh/save; active snapshots decision!=0, resets, marks need_refresh and requests safe save only for that saved Boolean.

Active rest sets restingtrue, active continue false; neither clears inProgress. Both temporarily use start map/position/updirection, request safe save and then restore live map/position/direction on normal return, even when returned Booleanfalse.
No ensure/rescue surrounds temporary map/position writes and Game.save. A propagated exception before restoration leaves the committed position prefix; it is distinct from a caught IO false return.

Game.save validates first, then writes safesave/save_count/magic_number/time prefix; only IOError/SystemCallError from its begin block are caught, decrementing save_count and returningfalse. Other exceptions propagate; no session rollback or disk-success guarantee follows from the request.
Only inProgress AddWin increments battleNumber and wins together. MatchOver is true inactive/nonzero decision or when battleNumber>numRounds, so third win frombattleNumber1 gives4>3.
Event in-challenge delegates actual inProgress, regardless of resting. nextTrainer uses trainers[battleNumber−1]; no separate paused-state exclusion.
